headline: Prime SSE at 2.5ft with offshore mornings — the pick of the day.
today: This is the standout: SSE at the prime angle, 1.5-2.5ft with offshore N wind through the morning going light NW midday. Fun for shortboards and fish on the peaks, cleaner and bigger than anything to the west. Worth the drive if you want the best waves around today — surf the morning before the WSW cross fills in by evening.

daysToWatch.note: NE gale 20-23mph all day — blown out and unsurfable regardless of swell. Skip.
Cross-off NNE but howling 20mph-plus on a short-period S swell. Groomed but tough, marginal.
